parquet_metadata.name: hpcmu.tool_version
parquet_metadata.meaning: the hpc-model-utils version that ran the export

parquet_metadata.name: hpcmu.model
parquet_metadata.meaning: the plugin name of the run (state.json plugin)

parquet_metadata.name: hpcmu.headers
parquet_metadata.meaning: the JSON list of the valid staging headers, in sample sort order

meaning_conventions: Δ is the difference between this sample's read and the previous one.
online CPUs is the number of cpuN lines in /proc/stat.
Every rate is null on a counter decrease, on a missing baseline, or after a failed read of its source.
The /proc/stat CPU columns follow the per-line ADR-093 rule written into their meanings.
A source whose read fails leaves every column of that source null in that sample; its rates are also null in the next sample, which has no baseline.
A source with nothing to read (no step component in the sampler's cgroup path, a workspace not on an NFS mount, no EFA device) leaves its columns null and writes no error line.
A float that is not finite is written as null.
Every cgroup column is null when the header's job_cgroup is null.
A header field whose source cannot be read or parsed, a malformed Slurm variable included, is null.

sample_columns.name: ts
sample_columns.meaning: scheduled sample instant, a multiple of interval_s on the wall-clock grid, except the off-grid final sample taken at SIGTERM or SIGINT; strictly increasing per staging file

sample_columns.name: phase
sample_columns.meaning: job phase, one of PHASES

sample_columns.name: job_id
sample_columns.meaning: Slurm job id (SLURM_JOB_ID)

sample_columns.name: restart
sample_columns.meaning: SLURM_RESTART_COUNT of the attempt, 0 when unset

sample_columns.name: node
sample_columns.meaning: Slurm node name (SLURMD_NODENAME), or the host name (uname nodename) when SLURMD_NODENAME is unset

sample_columns.name: node_index
sample_columns.meaning: SLURM_NODEID

sample_columns.name: seq
sample_columns.meaning: 0-based sample number within the staging file; a gap means a dropped line

sample_columns.name: dt_s
sample_columns.meaning: monotonic seconds since the previous counter read; for seq 0 the previous read is the unwritten start-up baseline

sample_columns.name: sample_cost_ms
sample_columns.meaning: sampler CPU time (getrusage user + system) spent on this sample, the workspace walk excluded

sample_columns.name: sampler_maxrss_bytes
sample_columns.meaning: sampler peak resident set size so far (ru_maxrss × 1024); ru_maxrss carries over execve, so it can only over-report

sample_columns.name: cpu_busy_cores
sample_columns.meaning: Δbusy / T × online CPUs from the /proc/stat cpu line, with Δbusy = Δ(user + nice + system + irq + softirq) and T = Δbusy + Δsteal + max(Δidle + Δiowait, 0); null when a busy field or steal decreases, when Δidle + Δiowait < −1, or when T ≤ 0; steal is not busy

sample_columns.name: cpu_util
sample_columns.meaning: cpu_busy_cores / online CPUs; null as cpu_busy_cores

sample_columns.name: cpu_user_cores
sample_columns.meaning: Δ(user + nice) / T × online CPUs; null as cpu_busy_cores

sample_columns.name: cpu_system_cores
sample_columns.meaning: Δ(system + irq + softirq) / T × online CPUs; null as cpu_busy_cores

sample_columns.name: cpu_iowait_cores
sample_columns.meaning: Δiowait / T × online CPUs; null as cpu_busy_cores, and also null when Δiowait < 0 or Δidle < 0

sample_columns.name: cpu_steal_cores
sample_columns.meaning: Δsteal / T × online CPUs; null as cpu_busy_cores

sample_columns.name: cpu_core_util_min
sample_columns.meaning: minimum over the cpuN lines of Δbusy / T of that CPU, under the same null rule per CPU; a CPU meeting the null rule is left out, and the value is null when every CPU is

sample_columns.name: cpu_core_util_p50
sample_columns.meaning: median over the cpuN lines of Δbusy / T of that CPU, under the same null rule per CPU; a CPU meeting the null rule is left out, and the value is null when every CPU is

sample_columns.name: cpu_core_util_max
sample_columns.meaning: maximum over the cpuN lines of Δbusy / T of that CPU, under the same null rule per CPU; a CPU meeting the null rule is left out, and the value is null when every CPU is

sample_columns.name: cpu_active_cores
sample_columns.meaning: number of cpuN lines with Δbusy / T >= 0.5, under the same null rule per CPU; null when every CPU is left out

sample_columns.name: load1
sample_columns.meaning: first field of /proc/loadavg

sample_columns.name: procs_running
sample_columns.meaning: procs_running of /proc/stat at the sample

sample_columns.name: procs_blocked
sample_columns.meaning: procs_blocked of /proc/stat at the sample

sample_columns.name: mem_used_bytes
sample_columns.meaning: (MemTotal − MemAvailable) × 1024

sample_columns.name: mem_available_bytes
sample_columns.meaning: MemAvailable × 1024

sample_columns.name: mem_anon_bytes
sample_columns.meaning: AnonPages × 1024

sample_columns.name: mem_cached_bytes
sample_columns.meaning: Cached × 1024

sample_columns.name: mem_shmem_bytes
sample_columns.meaning: Shmem × 1024; includes MPI shared-memory segments in /dev/shm

sample_columns.name: mem_dirty_bytes
sample_columns.meaning: Dirty × 1024

sample_columns.name: mem_writeback_bytes
sample_columns.meaning: Writeback × 1024

sample_columns.name: mem_slab_bytes
sample_columns.meaning: Slab × 1024

sample_columns.name: swap_used_bytes
sample_columns.meaning: (SwapTotal − SwapFree) × 1024

sample_columns.name: major_faults_per_s
sample_columns.meaning: Δpgmajfault / dt_s

sample_columns.name: oom_kills
sample_columns.meaning: Δoom_kill of /proc/vmstat in this interval

sample_columns.name: job_cpu_cores
sample_columns.meaning: (Δusage_usec of the job cgroup − Δusage_usec of the sampler's own step) / (1e6 × dt_s), clamped at 0; no subtraction when own_step_cgroup is null

sample_columns.name: job_mem_bytes
sample_columns.meaning: memory.current of the job cgroup − memory.current of the own step, clamped at 0; no subtraction when own_step_cgroup is null

sample_columns.name: job_mem_anon_bytes
sample_columns.meaning: memory.stat anon of the job cgroup − anon of the own step, clamped at 0; no subtraction when own_step_cgroup is null

sample_columns.name: job_mem_file_bytes
sample_columns.meaning: memory.stat file of the job cgroup − file of the own step, clamped at 0; no subtraction when own_step_cgroup is null

sample_columns.name: job_mem_shmem_bytes
sample_columns.meaning: memory.stat shmem of the job cgroup − shmem of the own step, clamped at 0; no subtraction when own_step_cgroup is null

sample_columns.name: job_mem_peak_bytes
sample_columns.meaning: memory.peak of the job cgroup: the kernel high-water mark since the cgroup was created, page cache and the sampler included; never subtracted

sample_columns.name: job_pids
sample_columns.meaning: pids.current of the job cgroup, the sampler step included; null when the job cgroup has no pids controller (pids.current absent)

sample_columns.name: job_oom_kills
sample_columns.meaning: Δoom_kill of the job cgroup's memory.events in this interval

sample_columns.name: psi_cpu_some
sample_columns.meaning: Δ some total (µs) of /proc/pressure/cpu / (1e6 × dt_s), clamped to [0, 1]

sample_columns.name: psi_mem_some
sample_columns.meaning: Δ some total of /proc/pressure/memory / (1e6 × dt_s), clamped to [0, 1]

sample_columns.name: psi_mem_full
sample_columns.meaning: Δ full total of /proc/pressure/memory / (1e6 × dt_s), clamped to [0, 1]

sample_columns.name: psi_io_some
sample_columns.meaning: Δ some total of /proc/pressure/io / (1e6 × dt_s), clamped to [0, 1]

sample_columns.name: psi_io_full
sample_columns.meaning: Δ full total of /proc/pressure/io / (1e6 × dt_s), clamped to [0, 1]

sample_columns.name: disk_read_bytes_per_s
sample_columns.meaning: Σ Δsectors read × 512 / dt_s over whole local disks (a /sys/block/<dev>/device entry, and a /sys/block/<dev>/hidden file that is absent or holds 0) present in both reads

sample_columns.name: disk_write_bytes_per_s
sample_columns.meaning: Σ Δsectors written × 512 / dt_s over the same disks

sample_columns.name: disk_busy_max
sample_columns.meaning: maximum over the same disks of Δio_ticks (ms) / (1000 × dt_s), clamped to [0, 1]

sample_columns.name: nfs_read_bytes_per_s
sample_columns.meaning: Δ(normalreadbytes + directreadbytes) / dt_s of the workspace mount (the mountstats entry whose mountpoint is the longest prefix of the workspace path, its symlinks resolved)

sample_columns.name: nfs_write_bytes_per_s
sample_columns.meaning: Δ(normalwritebytes + directwritebytes) / dt_s of the workspace mount

sample_columns.name: nfs_server_read_bytes_per_s
sample_columns.meaning: Δserverreadbytes / dt_s of the workspace mount

sample_columns.name: nfs_server_write_bytes_per_s
sample_columns.meaning: Δserverwritebytes / dt_s of the workspace mount

sample_columns.name: nfs_read_ops_per_s
sample_columns.meaning: ΔREAD ops / dt_s of the workspace mount

sample_columns.name: nfs_write_ops_per_s
sample_columns.meaning: ΔWRITE ops / dt_s of the workspace mount

sample_columns.name: nfs_ops_per_s
sample_columns.meaning: Δ(ops summed over every per-op line) / dt_s of the workspace mount; on node 0 it includes the walk's own operations

sample_columns.name: nfs_read_rtt_ms
sample_columns.meaning: ΔREAD rtt (ms) / ΔREAD ops; null when ΔREAD ops is 0

sample_columns.name: nfs_write_rtt_ms
sample_columns.meaning: ΔWRITE rtt (ms) / ΔWRITE ops; null when ΔWRITE ops is 0

sample_columns.name: net_rx_bytes_per_s
sample_columns.meaning: Σ Δreceive bytes / dt_s over interfaces with a /sys/class/net/<if>/device entry, present in both reads

sample_columns.name: net_tx_bytes_per_s
sample_columns.meaning: Σ Δtransmit bytes / dt_s over the same interfaces

sample_columns.name: net_errors_per_s
sample_columns.meaning: Σ Δ(rx errs + rx drop + tx errs + tx drop) / dt_s over the same interfaces

sample_columns.name: efa_rx_bytes_per_s
sample_columns.meaning: Σ Δhw_counters/rx_bytes / dt_s over /sys/class/infiniband/*/ports/1; null without an EFA device; MPI traffic over EFA bypasses net_*

sample_columns.name: efa_tx_bytes_per_s
sample_columns.meaning: Σ Δhw_counters/tx_bytes / dt_s over the same ports; null without an EFA device

workspace_columns.name: ts
workspace_columns.meaning: tick instant of the sample after which the walk ran

workspace_columns.name: restart
workspace_columns.meaning: SLURM_RESTART_COUNT of the attempt, 0 when unset

workspace_columns.name: node
workspace_columns.meaning: Slurm node name (SLURMD_NODENAME), or the host name (uname nodename) when SLURMD_NODENAME is unset

workspace_columns.name: apparent_bytes
workspace_columns.meaning: Σ lstat st_size over every entry below the workspace root, .hpcmu/telemetry excluded

workspace_columns.name: allocated_bytes
workspace_columns.meaning: Σ lstat st_blocks × 512 over the same entries

workspace_columns.name: fs_used_bytes
workspace_columns.meaning: (f_blocks − f_bfree) × f_frsize of the workspace filesystem

header_fields.name: kind
header_fields.meaning: line kind, hpcmu.telemetry.header

header_fields.name: schema_version
header_fields.meaning: telemetry schema version of the writer (SCHEMA_VERSION)

header_fields.name: tool_version
header_fields.meaning: hpc-model-utils version, from the sampler's --tool-version argument

header_fields.name: phase
header_fields.meaning: job phase, one of PHASES

header_fields.name: job_id
header_fields.meaning: Slurm job id (SLURM_JOB_ID)

header_fields.name: restart
header_fields.meaning: SLURM_RESTART_COUNT of the attempt, 0 when unset

header_fields.name: node
header_fields.meaning: Slurm node name (SLURMD_NODENAME), or the host name (uname nodename) when SLURMD_NODENAME is unset

header_fields.name: node_index
header_fields.meaning: SLURM_NODEID

header_fields.name: nodes
header_fields.meaning: SLURM_JOB_NUM_NODES; null when it is unset or empty

header_fields.name: partition
header_fields.meaning: SLURM_JOB_PARTITION, stripped; null when it is unset or blank

header_fields.name: cpus_on_node
header_fields.meaning: SLURM_JOB_CPUS_PER_NODE indexed by SLURM_NODEID, after expanding Slurm's compressed list (192(x2) is 192, 192); null when SLURM_JOB_CPUS_PER_NODE is unset or empty, or when SLURM_NODEID is outside the expanded list

header_fields.name: instance_type
header_fields.meaning: DMI product_name

header_fields.name: cpu_model
header_fields.meaning: value of the first model name line of /proc/cpuinfo

header_fields.name: ncpus
header_fields.meaning: online CPUs

header_fields.name: mem_total_bytes
header_fields.meaning: MemTotal × 1024

header_fields.name: kernel
header_fields.meaning: /proc/sys/kernel/osrelease

header_fields.name: job_cgroup
header_fields.meaning: /sys/fs/cgroup path of the job cgroup, the parent of the step component of /proc/self/cgroup; null without a step component

header_fields.name: own_step_cgroup
header_fields.meaning: /sys/fs/cgroup path of the sampler's own step, subtracted from the job values; null when the sampler's cgroup has no numbered step_N component (a step_batch, step_extern or step_interactive step, or no step), and then nothing is subtracted

header_fields.name: workspace_mount
header_fields.meaning: {mountpoint, fstype} of the mountstats entry whose mountpoint is the longest prefix of the workspace path, its symlinks resolved; null when no entry matches

header_fields.name: interval_s
header_fields.meaning: sample interval in seconds, the sampler's --interval argument

header_fields.name: workspace_interval_s
header_fields.meaning: configured workspace walk interval in seconds, the sampler's --workspace-interval argument

header_fields.name: started_at
header_fields.meaning: sampler start time, ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds and a Z

headline_poolings.name: node_rows
headline_poolings.meaning: the statistic over the rows of every node and restart pooled together, so the value is a per-node figure: a mean is the mean of one node and a max is the worst node

headline_poolings.name: sum_nodes
headline_poolings.meaning: the sum over the rows of every node and restart, a whole-job figure

headline_poolings.name: walks
headline_poolings.meaning: the statistic over the walks of the reported jobs

headline_formats.name: bytes
headline_formats.meaning: an integer number of bytes, rounded half to even, written as plain digits

headline_formats.name: fraction
